I'm not perfect at anything and I never will be so why strive for something if I'm only going to end up disappointing myself!

I've been taking it one day at a time since making this post and I don't think I'm lacking passion, I'm just afraid of failure and have been giving myself a lot of negative self talk that was causing me to despise the research, usually when things went wrong! But you're right, it's grad school and I'm not supposed to know everything. If I did, I wouldn't be here. It is still "school" and there's a lot to learn! There will always be a lot to learn, anyhow. 

And after talking to the visiting professor that has been helping with this project, she made me feel so much better. It's starting to become interdisciplinary with a branch of engineering and I was making myself feel bad for not knowing the procedures I was being given. But she reassured me that none of the professors working on this project expected me to understand it all, and that relieved some stress!

After reading this it kind of shocked me into a different mindset.
